About this home

This bright & refreshing 3-bed, 3-bath Bungalow was meticulously remodeled over the years, blending timeless style with modern upgrades. The living room features an elegant tile fireplace flanked by precious built-in cabinets & striking Alaskan Hickory hardwood flooring that flows out into the rest of the living areas. A graceful archway introduces an inviting dining room with a pair of picture windows that embrace the door to a cozy outdoor sitting area. The kitchen was impressively remodeled in 2024 with a stunning backsplash made of hand-crafted Moroccan Zellige tile, quartz countertops, farmhouse sink & an 8-foot quartz island, a 5-burner gas stove, double oven, wine fridge, & built-in microwave. All three bathrooms were carefully remodeled down to the studs, one with pristine floor-to-ceiling marble tile in the shower, the others with trendy subway tiles. The glass sliders in the generous family room open to an extensively remodeled & landscaped backyard--boasting a charming pergola-covered patio and a fully equipped outdoor kitchen with a gas-plumbed 32' grill, dual side burners, refrigerator, stainless steel storage drawers, and ambient lighting. The yard is perfected by a luxurious saltwater pool in the distance, featuring PebbleTec finish, heater, and updated decking--a breathtaking & versatile space built for both simple relaxation & hosting large get-togethers!

Key things to know

  • Bright 3-bed, 3-bath bungalow with Alaskan Hickory floors and tile fireplace.
  • 2024 remodeled kitchen features Moroccan Zellige backsplash, quartz island, gas stove, wine fridge.
  • All three baths remodeled to studs with marble and subway tile showers.
  • Outdoor living includes pergola, outdoor kitchen, and a saltwater PebbleTec pool.
  • Outdoor kitchen with grill, fridge, lighting, and a two-car garage.
